description: Definitive LLM output requirements for AI Animated Education pipeline. LLM is the 'brain' - all timing, durations, and creative decisions come from LLM output. Player is a dumb display layer with NO FALLBACKS.

llm_is_brain.description: LLM is the sole source of truth for ALL timing and durations
rules: Player consumes LLM output without modification
No duration calculations in player or post-processing
If timing is wrong, fix the LLM prompt, not the player

no_fallbacks.description: There are NO FALLBACKS. Missing required fields = LLM generation failure
rules: If visual_content is missing for intro/summary/memory, it's a BUG in LLM output
If recap_scenes is missing for recap, it's a BUG in LLM output
Player should NOT gracefully degrade - it should fail loudly
Do not fall back to narration_segments when visual_content is required

standalone_beat_rule.description: Each beat video is a complete snapshot (cumulative state), not a delta
rules: LLM decides what persists from beat to beat
Renderer shows complete state for each beat

intro.description: Welcome message, avatar speaking only - NO visual content displayed

required_fields.title: string
required_fields.narration: Full narration text (15-25 words welcoming students)
required_fields.narration_segments: Array with duration for each segment

example.narration: Namaste students! Welcome to today's lesson on Linear Equations. Please take out your notebooks and pens. Let's begin!

narration_segments.text: Namaste students! Welcome to today's lesson on Linear Equations.
Please take out your notebooks and pens. Let's begin!

summary.description: Learning objectives displayed as bullet points

required_fields.title: string (e.g., 'Learning Objectives')
required_fields.narration: Full narration reading each objective with context
required_fields.narration_segments: Array with duration for each segment (one per bullet)

bullet_points: Understand what a linear equation represents
Learn to solve equations using balance method
Apply linear equations to real-world problems

example.narration: In this lesson, we will cover three main objectives. First, we will understand what a linear equation represents...

narration_segments.text: In this lesson, we will cover three main objectives.
First, we will understand what a linear equation represents.
Second, we will learn to solve equations using the balance method.
Third, we will apply linear equations to real-world problems.

content.description: Main teaching content with synchronized visuals

required_fields.title: string
required_fields.renderer: manim | wan_video (LLM decides based on subject)
required_fields.narration_segments: Array with id, text, duration for each segment
required_fields.visual_beats: Array of renderer instructions (one per narration_segment)

required_fields.title: string (problem statement)
required_fields.narration_segments: Array with duration for each step
required_fields.visual_beats: Array of step visualizations (one per narration_segment)

rules: Show geometry, symbols, vectors, intermediate results
Examples must NEVER be explained only in words

required_fields.title: string (e.g., 'Key Concepts to Remember')
required_fields.narration_segments: Array with duration for each flashcard explanation

flashcards.title: Remember Balance
flashcards.description: Both sides of equation must stay equal

flashcards.title: Apply Operations
flashcards.description: Do same operation on both sides

flashcards.title: Solve for Variable
flashcards.description: Isolate the unknown step by step

recap.description: Mental movie storytelling with 5 animated scenes using WAN video generation

required_fields.title: string (e.g., 'Chapter Recap')
required_fields.narration: Combined narration from all scenes (300-500 words total)

recap_scenes_structure.wan_prompt: CONCRETE video generation prompt (no vague phrases)
recap_scenes_structure.word_count: integer - actual word count of narration (required for validation)

deprecated.infographic_prompt: DEPRECATED - use recap_scenes with wan_prompt instead

validation.word_count_field: REQUIRED in each scene for self-audit

recap_scenes.wan_prompt: Flat vector illustration, bright colors, Indian educational textbook style, purple gradient background. Traditional weighing scale (tarazu) with 'x + 5' on left pan and '10' on right pan, perfectly balanced. Equation 'x + 5 = 10' in corner.
recap_scenes.narration: Imagine a traditional weighing scale, called a tarazu, perfectly balanced with weights on both sides. A linear equation works exactly like this - whatever you have on the left side must equal what is on the right side. When we write x plus five equals ten, we are saying these two quantities are perfectly balanced. This balance is the heart of algebra.

structure: at least one content section exists
content: each visual_beat has concrete visual_instruction (no banned phrases)
memory: exactly 3 flashcards with letter, title, description
recap: each scene has narration with 60-100 words
each wan_prompt has no banned vague phrases

no_fallbacks: Do NOT fall back to narration_segments if visual_content missing
Do NOT fall back to narration if bullet_points missing
If required field missing, show error state
timing: Use beat.duration for visual beat timing
Do NOT calculate durations from audio length
